determination_rationale: Withheld: the source theory is not fully implemented. The prior major_restructuring label is withdrawn: replacing @ with parameters in an unfinished artifact did not establish that DTS had to be re-founded. DTS_Resolution.v now implements typed entity-projection holes, search and substitution, but not unrestricted dependent type checking or proof search.
